messages.subject: short courses at IMPS 2022
parts:
Yves and I are both teaching short courses for the IMPS conference this July in 2022, in case they are of interest to any lavaan users:

https://www.psychometricsociety.org/imps2022-shortcourses

Mine is about running simulations for SEM using lavaan and simsem.  A special case of this would be for a Monte Carlo power analysis.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen

messages.subject: Re: short courses at IMPS 2022
parts:
Quick question about attending your and Yves courses. We would need to register into the conference or this will be online later (with materials?)?

Woops, forgot to mention that.  No, if you want to only attend the short course, it is not necessary to attend the conference itself.  However, it is only offered in person, not online.
